description: Read this person's web watches and what they found. No arguments: every page and topic watch with what it watches, how often, its status and when it last checked and last found something. monitor_key alone: that watch and its ten latest changes. changes: true: the change and finding history, newest first, narrowed by monitor_key, domain (e.g. 'acme.com', every watched page there), since (YYYY-MM-DD), kind and limit; use it for 'what changed on competitor sites this week'. Topic findings carry their date, text and sources. change_id: one change in full, with its line diff (- removed, + added) or the fields' before and after values.

change_id.description: One change or finding to read in full.

changes.description: true lists changes and findings instead of watches.

domain.description: History only: a site's domain, e.g. 'acme.com'.

kind.description: History only: page changes or topic findings.

monitor_key.description: The watch key, pmon_..., from get_web_watches.

since.description: History only: on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_web_watches
title: Web watches
